target.statement: At a matched 10K SFT budget, two rounds of VeriEvol evolution improve the five-benchmark mean accuracy from 35.42 to 36.79 (+1.37) over one round of evolution.
target.table_ref: Table 4 / Section 4.3 (Scaling Axis 4: evolution depth at fixed budget)
target.dataset: Five-benchmark visual math suite at 10K SFT samples: MathVista_MINI, MathVision_MINI, MathVerse-VO, DynaMath, We-Math

compute.basis: The target requires constructing two rounds of evolved SFT data with proprietary teacher models, fine-tuning Qwen2.5-VL-7B twice on 10K samples, and evaluating five multimodal math benchmarks; this is far beyond an 8-core CPU / 16 GB laptop and the released links do not point to the VeriEvol code or the evolved corpora.

blockers: Requires fine-tuning Qwen2.5-VL-7B, which is not feasible on an 8-core CPU / 16 GB RAM laptop without a GPU.
Data construction uses closed-source proprietary teachers (Seed-2.0-Pro for SFT, Gemini-3-flash for RL), so the evolution step cannot be reproduced from the paper alone.
The listed code links are a generic GitHub placeholder and an unrelated R1-V repository; no usable VeriEvol code/config release is provided.
The evolved 10K SFT one-round and two-round corpora and model checkpoints needed for the target are not directly downloadable from the provided links.
Evaluation on five VLMEvalKit benchmarks requires substantial multimodal model inference even after training.
title: VeriEvol: Scaling Multimodal Mathematical Reasoning via Verifiable Evol-Instruct
